name: rooms-2: the school corridor and Nana's kitchen, four walls each, Sunburst, under everything learned on 21 Oct 2026
notes: Owner: 'generate another couple of rooms with Sunburst taking into consideration the additional things you've learned'. Gotchas 18 to 26 are in: objects in thirds, colours and band named on every wall, sizes tied to the band, corners that name the neighbour's end and what is out of view, wordless sketches, no finished-wall chains, the checks line naming the extras models add (chairs, blinds, plants).

Two settings the classroom did not cover: open doorways with a glimpse through (the corridor, three of them) and a different house altogether (Nana's kitchen: sage panelling, terracotta tiles, evening light from a window and an open door, no lettering at all).
Benchmarks in the game: next/art/school/h1-h4 and next/art/nana/k1-k4, made by Nano Banana Pro.
